name: Supreme vs StockX margin tracking
warnings: Taille non enregistrée pour le Puffer Pink et le Textured Sweater Pink sur StockX, à confirmer (seul le Puffer Black a une taille XL)
La feuille « TEST Holo computer use » n'est pas dans les ressources n8n disponibles, l'écriture est faite par Holo

blocks.name: Holo — lire prix Supreme Puffer Pink
steps: In Google Chrome, open https://eu.supreme.com/collections/all. Scroll through the product grid and find the product titled « Reversible Reflective Down Puffer Jacket » in the PINK colorway. Click on it to open the product page. Verify the page title contains « Reversible Reflective Down Puffer Jacket » and the color shown is Pink. Read the retail price displayed on the page (the price in euros, e.g. 528). Copy the number EXACTLY as displayed (without the € symbol, without currency code).

expect.prix_supreme: retail price as a number, e.g. 528

blocks.name: Holo — lire prix StockX Puffer Pink
steps: In Google Chrome, open https://stockx.com. In the search bar at the top, type « reversible reflective down puffer » and press Enter. In the search results, find and click on the product « Supreme Reversible Reflective Down Puffer Jacket » in PINK. Verify the page title contains « Supreme Reversible Reflective Down Puffer Jacket » and the color is Pink. Read the « Buy Now » price displayed on the page. Copy the number EXACTLY as displayed (without the € symbol, without currency code, without thousands separator).

expect.prix_stockx: Buy Now price as a number, e.g. 1361

blocks.name: Holo — écrire dans Google Sheets
steps: In Google Chrome, open the Google Sheet titled « TEST Holo computer use » (it should already be open in a tab; if not, find it in Google Sheets). Navigate to the sheet. In cell B4, type: {{Préparer la ligne.Puffer Pink - Prix Supreme}}. In cell C4, type: {{Préparer la ligne.Puffer Pink - Prix StockX}}. In cell D4, type the formula: =C4-B4. In cell B5, type: {{Préparer la ligne.Puffer Black - Prix Supreme}}. In cell C5, type: {{Préparer la ligne.Puffer Black - Prix StockX}}. In cell D5, type the formula: =C5-B5. In cell B6, type: {{Préparer la ligne.Textured Sweater Pink - Prix Supreme}}. In cell C6, type: {{Préparer la ligne.Textured Sweater Pink - Prix StockX}}. In cell D6, type the formula: =C6-B6. Press Enter after each cell entry. Do not modify any other cells. Stop when all 9 cells are filled.
